title: The typed decision *layer.*
sub: One lead, from list to reply. Where code decides, where a model decides, where a person decides.

legend.typed: a typed-decision model picks from closed options

rail.head: Why it exists
lines: They were scored low. Nobody saw it.

rail.head: Select, never generate
lines: The model picks from your list.
It can still pick the wrong one. That is what UNRESOLVED is for.

stages.title: A lead lands
stages.note: List import, CRM record or inbound form.

cards.title: Compute before you ask
lines: Days since last touch: code, never the model

cards.title: Disqualify in code
lines: Agencies, below your size floor, existing customers

stages.title: Three decisions, one call
stages.note: Same lead state, one round trip, three typed answers.

cards.title: Worth paying to enrich?
lines: A wrong call costs one fee

stages.title: Route on confidence
stages.note: choice and score carry a confidence. noul does not.

cards.title: UNRESOLVED and low confidence
lines: Never defaulted to a low score

bands.caption: TypeSafe's worked example, not a rule. Destructive actions only above 0.9.

stages.title: Enrol and write
stages.note: The decision is made. Now the words.

stages.title: A reply comes back
stages.note: Reply text is its own state, so it is its own call.

cards.title: Answer the objection
lines: Written after it was tagged objection

stages.title: Learn from outcomes
stages.note: The layer is only as good as its calibration.

lines: Threshold by error rate AND review share
